Mirrors

VideoLAN2 min readvideolan.org/videolan/mirrors.html

The VideoLAN projects rely on several mirrors distributed
around the globe in order to provide faster downloads for
everyone. These servers are kindly operated by sponsors
and managed by Mirrorbits.
To be part of our mirror infrastructure please contact us.
